entries.title: Ephesians 3:1
segments: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Jesus, the Christ, for the sake of you Gentiles--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:2
segments: For you have heard, I suppose, of the responsible charge with which God entrusted me for your benefit,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:3
segments: And also that it was by direct revelation that the hidden purpose of God was made known to me, as I have already briefly told you.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:4
segments: And, by reading what I have written, you will be able to judge how far I understand this hidden purpose of God in Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:5
segments: In former generations it was not made known to mankind, as fully as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to the Apostles and Prophets among Christ's People--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:6
segments: That, by union with Christ Jesus and through the Good News, the Gentiles are co-heirs with us and members of one Body, and that they share with us in God's Promise.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:7
segments: Of this Good News I became a minister, in virtue of the charge with which God entrusted me in the exercise of his power--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:8
segments: Yes, to me, who am less than the least of all Christ's People, was this charge entrusted!--to tell the Gentiles the Good News of the boundless wealth to be found in the Christ,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:9
segments: And to make clear what is God's way of working out that hidden purpose which from the first has been concealed in the mind of the Creator of all things;

entries.title: Ephesians 3:10
segments: So that now to the Archangels and to all the Powers on high should be made known, through the Church, the all-embracing wisdom of God,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:11
segments: In accordance with that purpose which runs through all the ages and which he has now accomplished in Jesus, the Christ, our Master.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:12
segments: And in union with him, and through our trust in him, we find courage to approach God with confidence.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:13
segments: Therefore I beg you not to be disheartened at the sufferings that I am undergoing for your sakes; for they redound to your honor.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:14
segments: For this reason, then, I kneel before the Father--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:15
segments: From whom all 'fatherhood' in Heaven and on earth derives its name--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:16
segments: And pray that, in proportion to the wealth of his glory, he will strengthen you with his power by breathing his Spirit into your inmost soul,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:17
segments: So that the Christ, through your faith, may make his home within your hearts in love; And I pray that you, now firmly rooted and established, may, with all Christ's People,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:18
segments: Have the power to comprehend in all its width and length and height and depth,

entries.title: Ephesians 3:19
segments: And to understand--though it surpasses all understanding--the love of the Christ; and so be filled to the full with God himself.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20
segments: To him who, through his power which is at work within us, is able to do far more than anything that we can ask or conceive--

entries.title: Ephesians 3:21
segments: To him be all glory through the Church and through Christ Jesus, for all generations, age after age. Amen.
